resources.name: DFT code with HSE06 hybrid functional and Berry phase polarization calculation

access.notes: Must implement HSE06 screened hybrid functional with tunable exact-exchange fraction and the modern theory of polarization (Berry phase). Open-source alternatives (e.g., CP2K, GPAW) are acceptable.

resources.name: Pseudopotential library for Sr, Ti, O

access.notes: SSSP efficiency 1.1 or equivalent PSlibrary; choose a library compatible with the chosen DFT code and HSE06 functional.
